projectSummary: A second measurement-validity qualifier: the imaging plane changes the cross-sectional area obtained for this muscle. Tier-1 values measured on different planes are not interchangeable.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; used for a qualifier only.

study.population: The study asked whether pectoralis major and triceps brachii anatomical cross-sectional area calculated from different MRI planes presents a similar muscle size-strength relationship, noting that these muscles are often acquired and analysed on the axial plane.

title: Pectoralis major and triceps brachii cross-sectional area measured on different planes: the effect on the muscle size-strength relationship.
